effect_description_eng: [On Play] [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card with [Numemon] or [Sukamon] in its name in your hand, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn.
